{{Infobox | title = BITwiki Dependency Schema | description = SMW property definitions for template and fragment dependency tracking | type = schema-matter | category = dependency-management }} = BITwiki Dependency Schema = == Purpose == Proactive tracking of transclusion dependencies using SMW properties to detect circular references before they cause parse failures. == Property Definitions == === Property:Depends on === [[Has type::Page]] [[Has description::Template or fragment that this artifact depends on]] [[Has property scope::Template, Fragment]] === Property:Required by === [[Has type::Page]] [[Has description::Templates or fragments that depend on this artifact]] [[Has property scope::Template, Fragment]] === Property:Has dependency depth === [[Has type::Number]] [[Has description::Maximum depth of dependency chain from this artifact]] [[Has property scope::Template, Fragment]] == Template Integration == Add to each template's section: 

[[Has entity type::Concept]]
[[Depends on::Template:Infobox Core]]
[[Depends on::Module:Validation]]
== Fragment Integration == Add to each fragment: 

...content...

[[Depends on::Template:Infobox Concept]]
[[Has fragment level::L1]]
== Circular Detection Query == Detect potential circular dependencies: 
{{#ask: [[Depends on::{{PAGENAME}}]]
|?Depends on
|format=table
|limit=50
}}
== Dependency Chain Query == Trace full dependency chain: 
{{#ask: [[Depends on::+]]
|?Depends on
|?Required by
|format=table
|limit=100
}}
== Validation Rules == = All templates must declare dependencies = = No circular chains allowed (A → B → C → A) = = Maximum dependency depth: 5 levels = = Update dependencies when refactoring = = Document breaking changes in talk page = == Automated Checks == Pre-commit validation should: = Parse all [[Depends on::]] declarations = = Build dependency graph = = Detect cycles using DFS = = Report depth violations = == Breaking Change Protocol == When removing or renaming a dependency: = Update all dependent templates first = = Add redirect if renaming = = Document in [[BITwiki Changelog]] = = Notify via [[Category:Breaking Changes]] = [[Category:BITwiki Schema Matter]] [[Category:Dependency Management]] [[Category:System Documentation]]
